title: Sample metadata schema
description: JSON schema for validating sample metadata in MetaSBT

sample_id.title: Sample ID
sample_id.description: Unique identifier for the sample within the dataset

link.title: External Link
link.description: URL or external reference for the sample

EcosystemClassification.title: Ecosystem Classification
EcosystemClassification.description: Ecosystem classification based on the GOLD database (https://gold.jgi.doe.gov/distribution#Classification)

enum: Tomato and mustards seeds in 2% brine

SequencingMetadata.title: Sequencing Metadata
SequencingMetadata.description: Metadata related to sequencing and data generation

minimum_read_length.title: Minimum Read Length
minimum_read_length.description: Minimum read length in base pairs

median_read_length.title: Median Read Length
median_read_length.description: Median read length in base pairs

NCBI_accession.title: NCBI Accession
NCBI_accession.description: NCBI BioProject or SRA accession number

PMID.title: PubMed ID
PMID.description: PubMed identifier for the study publication

SubjectInfo.title: Subject Information
SubjectInfo.description: Demographic and personal information about the subject

age_category.title: Age Category
age_category.description: Categorical age group of the subject

non_westernized.title: Non-Westernized
non_westernized.description: Does the subject come from a non-westernized country?

travel_destination.title: Travel Destination
travel_destination.description: Recent travel destination of the subject

BMI.title: Body Mass Index
BMI.description: Body mass index of the subject

birth_control_pil.title: Birth Control Pill
birth_control_pil.description: Whether the subject uses birth control pills

premature.title: Premature
premature.description: Whether the subject was born prematurely

age_twins_started_to_live_apart.title: Age Twins Started to Live Apart

family_role.title: Family Role

wild.title: Wild

ClinicalData.title: Clinical Data
ClinicalData.description: Clinical and medical information about the subject

disease.title: Disease
disease.description: Disease or condition of the subject

bleeding_sites_6_months.title: Bleeding Sites (6 Months)
bleeding_sites_6_months.description: Number of bleeding sites at 6-month follow-up

bleeding_sites_T0.title: Bleeding Sites (Baseline)
bleeding_sites_T0.description: Number of bleeding sites at baseline

days_after_onset.title: Days After Onset
days_after_onset.description: Number of days after disease onset

antibiotics_current_use.title: Current Antibiotics Use
antibiotics_current_use.description: Whether the subject is currently using antibiotics

remission.title: Remission
remission.description: Whether the subject is in remission

ajcc.title: AJCC Stage
ajcc.description: American Joint Committee on Cancer staging

fobt.title: Fecal Occult Blood Test
fobt.description: Result of fecal occult blood test

shigatoxin_2_elisa.title: Shigatoxin 2 ELISA
shigatoxin_2_elisa.description: Result of Shiga toxin 2 ELISA test

alcohol.title: Alcohol Consumption
alcohol.description: Alcohol consumption status of the subject

BASDAI.title: BASDAI Score
BASDAI.description: Bath Ankylosing Spondylitis Disease Activity Index

ferm_milk_prod_consumer.title: Fermented Milk Product Consumer
ferm_milk_prod_consumer.description: Whether the subject consumes fermented milk products

hitchip_probe_class.title: HITChip Probe Class
hitchip_probe_class.description: Human Intestinal Tract Chip probe classification

age_T1D_diagnosis.title: Age at Type 1 Diabetes Diagnosis
age_T1D_diagnosis.description: Age at which type 1 diabetes was diagnosed

HLA.title: HLA Genotype (General)
HLA.description: General human leukocyte antigen genotype information

days_from_first_collection.title: Days from First Collection
days_from_first_collection.description: Number of days since the first sample collection

additional_data.title: Additional Data
additional_data.description: Additional data related to the sample object
